title: 木造在来 ベタ基礎 基礎伏図 1/50・基礎詳細図 1/25 作図ルール (社内練習データ 住宅A から抽出)

drawings: 住宅A 基礎伏図 (練習用)
住宅A 基礎詳細図 (練習用)
derivedFrom.environment: 住宅A 1/50 基礎伏・アンカー図 JWF, 基礎断面詳細 JWF
derivedFrom.method: codec decode + per-layer montage (group 1 = 基礎伏, group C = traced plan) + offsets relative to X1/Y1; FG1 detail measured at 1/25 (2026-10-02)
derivedFrom.privacy: Rules only. No client names, addresses, staff, company or logo data are stored here.

plan.practiceExtra: group C = 1/50 floor plan traced underneath (reference), group 3 = 1/25 床下AC detail, group 9 = memos

details.practice: group 2 at 1/25 = FG1 / porch details, group 1 at 1/10 = column post detail

layers.1:0: 910 grid (+455 lines used by foundation lines), chain pen 4 style 5, clipped to the footprint
layers.1:1: 立上り: faces ±75 pen 2 (union outline, clean T junctions), EPS face -175 pen 7, mortar face -200 pen 1, footing inner edge +200 pen 3 style 3 (hidden)
layers.1:2: 地中梁 FG (under the slab): faces ±300 pen 1 style 4 (dashed)
layers.1:3: 鋼製束: circle R50 + cross ±100, pen 6 (practice block 鋼製束, 86 posts)
layers.1:4: アンカーボルト (generator; practice draws them on the 1/25 details only)
layers.1:5: 人通口: dashed closing lines across the riser opening
layers.1:6: 耐圧版 mark: triple 45° lines pen 4
layers.1:7: 床下点検口 (dashed rect), floor grilles in practice
layers.1:8: ハッチ: 地中梁 45° hatch pen 7
layers.1:A: grid bubbles R150 + 3.5 mm labels, stubs pen 7 style 5
layers.1:B: 色塗: riser fill e2e2e2, EPS band pink COLORREF e5e5ff
layers.1:D: 文字: 耐圧版180t / -400, 土間, legend, title
layers.1:E: 寸法: foundation-line tier + overall on all four sides, 実点

measured.method: Practice house A foundation plan, model mm (file x 50) relative to X1/Y1

interior.practice: 地中梁 (grade beams) 600 wide under the slab instead of interior risers: FG2 4-D13, FG3 (上下各)3-D13, STP D10@300; the floor void is one compartment heated by an underfloor AC
interior.generatorDefault: riser under every interior (bearing) wall of the plan spec; building.foundation.interior = 'grade-beam' reproduces house A

doma.riser: own riser rectangle around the 玄関土間

anchors.practice: アンカーボルト M12 (L=400) in the column-post detail
anchors.rule: standard (フラット35 / 公庫仕様, not measured on the plan): within 200 of corner, junction and opening-jamb columns on each riser, spacing <= 2,730 (3 modules), not inside 人通口

manholes.rule: standard (not in practice A): link every floor-void compartment to the 床下点検口 compartment; prefer positions under interior doorways (no bearing wall above), else mid-span between columns, >= 300 clear of columns

dimensions.tiers: foundation lines (riser / beam centres) and overall

notes: 地業: ランマー締め固め
コンクリート Fc=21N/mm² スランプ18cm
地盤調査: スクリューウエイト貫入試験 / 地盤改良は調査の上決定

fg1Detail.insulation: 外側 EPS 100 (-175) GL-510..+400, 内側 EPS 50 footing top..slab bottom, skirt EPS 50 x 450 at about GL-230 falling 5 %
fg1Detail.rebar: 上端 1-D13, 下端 1-D13, タテ D10@200, ヨコ D10@300, 耐圧版 D13@200 タテヨコ, かぶり 60 (土に接する底)

layers.2:9: levels 基礎天端 ▽ / 設計GL ▼, 土台 dashed
